legend: After spending an hour and a half on the final Mathematics exam, struggling in vain to find the answers to the devilish questions that have come up, you decide it's time to give up, make up the remaining answers, submit, and pray for a passing grade. Fortunately for you, the exam is multiple choice, and each question has three possible options: A, B, or C, and you already know some of the answers. Each correct answer is worth one point, and incorrect answers do not subtract points. You remember from the practice exams you took yesterday that the teacher never puts two consecutive questions with the same answer, meaning that if question 1 is A, then question 2 cannot be A. Your goal is to fill out the exam in such a way that you maximize the number of points you can secure in the worst-case scenario.
input: The input will consist of an integer t$$$t$$$, followed by t$$$t$$$ test cases. Each case will have on one line N$$$N$$$, the number of questions on the exam, and on the next line a string with N$$$N$$$ characters. The i$$$i$$$-th character will be 'A', 'B', or 'C' if you know the answer to question i$$$i$$$, and '?' if you do not know it.
output: One line per case with the number of points you can secure on the exam.
11 points: 1≤N≤105$$$1 \leq N \leq 10^5$$$, t=50$$$t = 50$$$, no two '?' are consecutive.

legend.ai: 在期末数学考试上花了一个半小时，苦寻那些魔鬼题目的答案而不得之后，你决定是时候放弃了，编上剩下的答案，交卷，然后祈祷能及格。幸运的是，考试全是选择题，每题有三个选项：A、B 或 C，而且你已经知道部分答案。每道正确答案得 1 分，答错不扣分。你记得昨天做的模拟试卷中，老师从不会让连续两道题的答案相同，也就是说如果第 1 题是 A，那么第 2 题不能是 A。你的目标是填写试卷，使得在最坏情况下你也能确保获得尽可能多的分数。

input.ai: 输入由一个整数 t$$$t$$$ 组成，后跟 t$$$t$$$ 个测试用例。每个测试用例的第一行包含 N$$$N$$$，即考试题目数量；下一行是一个长度为 N$$$N$$$ 的字符串。第 i$$$i$$$ 个字符如果是 'A'、'B' 或 'C'，表示你知道第 i$$$i$$$ 题的答案；如果是 '?'，表示你不知道。

output.ai: 每个测试用例输出一行，包含你在考试中能确保获得的分数。
